subject: [PATCH v2 07/11] nfsd: recall when a CB_GETATTR reply omits the size

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue in the NFSv4 callback code where a CB_GETATTR reply without the SIZE attribute would cause the waiter to incorrectly report the file size and mark it as modified, leading to incorrect behavior. The patch adds a new bitmap field to hold word 0 of the reply's bitmap and checks for this condition in nfsd4_cb_getattr_done(). If the SIZE attribute is missing, the callback is failed and the delegation is recalled.
